scientific_integrity: The mathematical statements are established by explicit coefficient proof with standalone finite-case verification; no independent validation or priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: All-field structural proof for labeled split coordinate algebras, with exact characteristic-three finite-field rank and square-zero enumerators. Does not classify nonsplit etale forms, isomorphism orbits or other algebras; finite computational checks are not infinite proofs. Publication priority is provisional, including possible equivalent statements under averaging-operator terminology.
title: Weighted-block rigidity for anti–Rota–Baxter maps on split semisimple algebras
